text: He's been borrowing to cover it, I think. He's lost weight. Looks like he hasn't slept in months.
style: Marketing coordinator in her early thirties, British-Korean, raised in New Malden. Speak with a consistent south-west London accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Bright, mid-to-high pitch; quick, chatty pace. Warm and observant; she gossips because she cares about people.
